blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The House prosecution panel may submit its formal offer of evidence against Vice President Sara Z. Duterte ahead of the Oct. 23 deadline to help speed up the remaining proceedings in her impeachment trial. House prosecutor and Manila Rep. Joel Chua on Saturday said prosecutors were preparing the submission after formally resting their case on October 13, a day after their final witness completed his testimony. The Senate impeachment court gave the prosecution 10 days, or until Oct. 23, to formally offer the documentary and object evidence supporting Article II on Duterte’s alleged unexplained wealth. “Kung maibibigay po […]...
